decisionsToFreeze.decision: In base Persian state, when a collision has exactly one Persian-letter candidate and Latin lower/upper candidates, select the Persian letter before ambiguity policy.
If a collision has only Latin upper/lower candidates and no active Latin span, keep AMBIGUOUS_REVERSE_MATCH.
At 25 1234, prefer a syntactically valid closed Latin span when the opening dot-25 can be parsed through a matching Latin end; otherwise preserve standalone percent multi-cell punctuation precedence.
Strict ambiguity remains subordinate to an already-resolved parser state; base Persian or Latin-span state may resolve before strict ambiguity handling.

recommendedImplementationShape.basePersianChange: Broaden existing basePersianCandidate from digit-gated collisions to language-mode collisions while preserving the existing digit collision behavior.
recommendedImplementationShape.percentOverlapChange: Before preLatinPercentMatch consumes 25 1234, detect whether the current dot-25 begins a syntactically valid closable Latin span. If yes, let Latin-mode parsing proceed. If not, retain percent canonicalization.
recommendedImplementationShape.conformanceTarget: Materialize all 16 Latin/Persian signatures plus explicit percent-vs-Latin-p regression vectors; leave signature 23 for Phase 13.5c-3b.
